name: openclaw-membrane
description: Membrane graph-aware memory bridge — ingest events, search records, auto-inject context

api_key.description: Bearer token for authenticated Membrane gRPC requests

tls_ca_cert_path.description: Optional CA certificate path for TLS gRPC connections

scope.description: Scope assigned to captured OpenClaw memories

trust_scopes.description: Scopes allowed during retrieval. Defaults to [scope] when scope is set; retrieval is disabled when both are empty.

context_limit.description: Maximum graph roots to retrieve for injected context; bounded graph expansion may include related neighbors

tools.name: membrane_search
tools.description: Search graph-aware Membrane records for relevant context

query.description: Natural language query to search memories

memory_types.description: Filter by memory type: episodic, working, semantic, competence, plan_graph, entity

commands.name: membrane
commands.description: Show Membrane connection status and memory stats
